about.title: About FanFiction AI
about.subtitle: Learn how to use our collaborative storytelling platform
about.rule1Description: We respect and prioritize human creativity over AI generation. The AI is here to assist and enhance your storytelling, not replace your imagination. Every story begins with human vision and passion.
about.rule2Description: Simple algorithms help make stories better through community collaboration. We're still discovering the best ways to blend human creativity with AI assistance to create amazing collaborative narratives.
about.rule3Description: As our community grows and evolves, we'll develop new principles based on what works best for collaborative storytelling. Your feedback helps shape our future.
about.step1Description: Click 'Create' to begin writing your story. Simply describe your story idea, including title, genre, and plot - our AI will help structure it into an engaging narrative.
about.step2Description: Browse existing stories and dive into different narrative paths. Each story can branch into multiple directions based on community input and plot twists.
about.step3Description: Leave comments on story nodes to share your thoughts, reactions, and suggestions. Your engagement helps authors understand what resonates with readers.
about.step4Description: Suggest new directions for stories by proposing plot twists. The community can vote on these suggestions, and popular twists may become part of the official story.
about.feature1Description: Stories evolve through reader participation and community voting on plot directions.
about.feature2Description: Our AI helps structure and enhance your creative ideas while keeping human creativity at the center.
about.feature3Description: Stories can split into multiple paths, allowing for diverse storytelling possibilities and reader choice.
about.feature4Description: Writers and readers work together to create rich, engaging stories that evolve over time.
about.communityDescription: Whether you're a writer looking to share your stories or a reader eager to influence narratives, there's a place for you in our collaborative storytelling community.
